title: Git and user work
description: Protect user changes and require precise authority for repository operations.
purpose: Keep task changes reviewable without discarding unrelated work.
requirements: git-and-user-work/preserve-work: Preserve unrelated files and all uncommitted user work unless exact destructive discard authority is explicit.
git-and-user-work/stage-exact: Inspect the diff and stage only files that belong to the active task.
git-and-user-work/commit-authority: Commit, push, history rewrite, and destructive discard each require explicit user authority; do not infer one from another.
git-and-user-work/report-repository-state: Report branch, dirty state, conflicts, and verification evidence before claiming a repository operation succeeded.
invariants: Preserve unrelated and uncommitted work; stage exact files; require explicit commit, push, history rewrite, or destructive discard authority.
